value_transformation: column aliases only; all rows, types and values preserved

columns.name: date_added_to_catalog
columns.description: Date published in the Catalog.

columns.name: pubmed_id
columns.description: PubMed publication identifier; several studies can share it.

columns.name: first_author
columns.description: First author as supplied.

columns.name: publication_date
columns.description: Publication date, not the Catalog release date.

columns.name: journal
columns.description: Journal name as supplied.

columns.name: publication_link
columns.description: Publication link as supplied; a URL scheme may be absent.

columns.name: study_title
columns.description: Paper title; accession_id identifies the Catalog study.

columns.name: disease_trait
columns.description: Reported disease/trait text, not an ontology identifier.

columns.name: initial_sample_size
columns.description: Free-text sample size/ancestry description.

columns.name: replication_sample_size
columns.description: Free-text replication description.

columns.name: region
columns.description: Cytogenetic region(s), preserved as source text.

columns.name: chromosome
columns.description: Chromosome value(s), not necessarily a single integer.

columns.name: chromosome_position
columns.description: Position value(s); multi-variant records remain text.

columns.name: reported_genes
columns.description: Author-reported genes; may contain multiple names.

columns.name: mapped_gene
columns.description: Catalog-mapped gene text; may list overlapping or flanking genes. Not a scalar gene identifier.

columns.name: upstream_gene_id
columns.description: Source upstream gene identifier(s); namespace retained.

columns.name: downstream_gene_id
columns.description: Source downstream gene identifier(s); namespace retained.

columns.name: snp_gene_ids
columns.description: Source overlapping gene identifier(s); may be multivalued.

columns.name: upstream_gene_distance
columns.description: Source upstream distance in base pairs.

columns.name: downstream_gene_distance
columns.description: Source downstream distance in base pairs.

columns.name: strongest_snp_risk_allele
columns.description: Variant/risk-allele text; '?' can denote unknown allele. Haplotypes remain unsplit.

columns.name: snps
columns.description: Source variant text; a haplotype can contain multiple rsIDs.

columns.name: merged
columns.description: Source merge flag (0/1); not converted to Boolean.

columns.name: snp_id_current
columns.description: Current SNP identifier as supplied; no rs prefix is added.

columns.name: context
columns.description: Source predicted functional consequence annotation.

columns.name: intergenic
columns.description: Source intergenic flag (0/1); not converted to Boolean.

columns.name: risk_allele_frequency
columns.description: Reported allele/haplotype frequency text; not cast to a number.

columns.name: p_value
columns.description: Reported Catalog p-value, with the source precision unchanged.

columns.name: pvalue_mlog
columns.description: Source negative log10 p-value; not recomputed.

columns.name: pvalue_text
columns.description: Context attached to the p-value, such as a subgroup.

columns.name: or_or_beta
columns.description: Combined source effect value: odds ratio OR beta. Do not assume one effect type or split it.

columns.name: ci_95_text
columns.description: Source confidence-interval/unit text; not parsed.

columns.name: platform_snps_passing_qc
columns.description: Platform and QC/imputation description; not a standalone numeric SNP count.

columns.name: cnv
columns.description: Source copy-number-variation flag text.

columns.name: mapped_trait
columns.description: Mapped trait label(s); source multivalue formatting is retained.

columns.name: mapped_trait_uri
columns.description: Mapped ontology URI(s); no descendant expansion, label matching or namespace conversion is applied.

columns.name: accession_id
columns.description: Catalog study accession; shared join key across the three views.

columns.name: genotyping_technology
columns.description: Source technology description(s).
